lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of approximately 10-12 vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible. These clusters are arranged in roughly equidistant horizontal rows across the mid-flank, creating a geometric pattern of localized maxima posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a matrix of anchor nodes where the highest pixel intensity is concentrated at the center of the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition where the superior edge is high-intensity and the inferior edge is in shadow, indicating raised anatomical ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of low-diameter high-luminance blobs, primarily located towards the anterior and central regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-intensity silhouettes representing commensal organisms (remoras) are visible in the water column immediately ventral to the pectoral fin and main body mass.
